slots.notes: Fullscreen autoplaying, muted, playsInline background video covering the entire viewport behind the centered signup card (object-cover); sets the page mood, no audio.

Square monochrome brand glyph rendered inline as an SVG path (viewBox 0 0 256 256), single-fill tinted by the accent color. Appears twice: 36px in the left-column brand lockup beside the wordmark, and 34px centered in the right glass panel. Transparent background.

mechanic: A fullscreen looping muted hero video sits behind a centered two-column glass card (dark opaque form column + translucent decorative panel), with all interaction signaled purely through Tailwind transition-colors hover/active states and no keyframe motion.
techDelivery: Single-page React 18 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Vite app using lucide-react icons only; no other UI libraries.
reskinNotes: Brand accent hex #DA3F23 is hardcoded both as the wordmark text color and as the fill on the inline SVG logo path, so the mark must be re-tinted in two places (and the glyph geometry itself is the brand's, not swappable as a generic socket); all copy strings (headline, CTA, terms, social labels) are hardcoded inline in JSX markup; fonts use the default Tailwind system stack with no custom families, so display/body cannot be reskinned without adding a font import; many surface tints are expressed as Tailwind zinc/* opacity utilities (zinc-800/70, zinc-700/60, zinc-500, zinc-400) rather than the named color roles.
